phrases.latin: ubi inter librōrum pluteōs torī magnī tōmentō fartī stant calōrisque radiātrum tepet
phrases.english: where big stuffed sofas stand among the bookshelves and the radiator is warm
phrases.source: Libellus III, Apud avum et aviam

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 124, checked against the searchable text of the book (29 October 2026).
Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word.
